project.name: Listen to Earth - The Earth Information Jukebox
project.purpose: Frontend demo data for turning Earth visualization features into sound
project.important_note: All numeric values in this file are fictional examples for frontend development. They are not measured NASA CO2 values and must not be presented as scientific observations.

frontend_features.title: Visual-to-Sound Playback
frontend_features.description: Play an audio representation of the selected visualization frame sequence.

frontend_features.title: Playback Controls
frontend_features.description: Allow users to play, pause, stop, and restart the sound.

frontend_features.title: Keyboard Accessibility
frontend_features.description: Support keyboard navigation and shortcuts for playback controls.

frontend_features.title: Screen Reader Support
frontend_features.description: Provide accessible labels and text descriptions for controls and playback status.

frontend_features.title: Frame Description
frontend_features.description: Show a short text description of the visual feature represented by the current frame.

frontend_features.title: Audio Settings
frontend_features.description: Allow the user to adjust volume and playback speed.

field_definitions.brightness: Mock normalized brightness value from 0 to 1.
field_definitions.red: Mock average red-channel value from 0 to 255.
field_definitions.green: Mock average green-channel value from 0 to 255.
field_definitions.blue: Mock average blue-channel value from 0 to 255.
field_definitions.dominant_channel: RGB channel with the highest mock average; not a scientific CO2 category.
field_definitions.left_brightness: Mock average brightness of the left image region.
field_definitions.right_brightness: Mock average brightness of the right image region.
field_definitions.change: Mock frame-to-frame visual change value from 0 to 1.
field_definitions.audio.note: Example musical note for frontend demonstration.
